question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        p.product_category_name as category,
        (oi.price - oi.freight_value) as profit
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers,
        SUM(profit) as total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_orders
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY category, seller_id
),
review_counts AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(1) as five_star_reviews
    FROM base_data
    JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON base_data.order_id = r.order_id AND r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY category, seller_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        sm.category,
        sm.seller_id,
        sm.distinct_customers,
        sm.total_profit,
        sm.distinct_orders,
        COALESCE(rc.five_star_reviews, 0) as five_star_reviews
    FROM seller_metrics sm
    LEFT JOIN review_counts rc ON sm.category = rc.category AND sm.seller_id = rc.seller_id
),
winner_customers AS (
    SELECT category, seller_id, distinct_customers
    FROM combined
    WHERE (category, distinct_customers) IN (
        SELECT category, MAX(distinct_customers) 
        FROM combined 
        GROUP BY category
    )
),
winner_profit AS (
    SELECT category, seller_id, total_profit
    FROM combined
    WHERE (category, total_profit) IN (
        SELECT category, MAX(total_profit) 
        FROM combined 
        GROUP BY category
    )
),
winner_orders AS (
    SELECT category, seller_id, distinct_orders
    FROM combined
    WHERE (category, distinct_orders) IN (
        SELECT category, MAX(distinct_orders) 
        FROM combined 
        GROUP BY category
    )
),
winner_reviews AS (
    SELECT category, seller_id, five_star_reviews
    FROM combined
    WHERE (category, five_star_reviews) IN (
        SELECT category, MAX(five_star_reviews) 
        FROM combined 
        GROUP BY category
    )
)
SELECT 
    category,
    'highest_distinct_customers' as achievement,
    seller_id,
    distinct_customers as value
FROM winner_customers
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    category,
    'highest_profit' as achievement,
    seller_id,
    total_profit as value
FROM winner_profit
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    category,
    'highest_distinct_orders' as achievement,
    seller_id,
    distinct_orders as value
FROM winner_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    category,
    'most_five_star_ratings' as achievement,
    seller_id,
    five_star_reviews as value
FROM winner_reviews
ORDER BY category, achievement
